lines: Day six. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Then it began to count its dead.
Four hundred and thirty-three men hold this line.
Two hundred and twenty-seven Hegemony in the north. Two hundred and six Concord in the south.
On Hill 304 stands a dead tree made of steel. Inside it, a Hegemony spotter watches every head.
A Concord sniper raised his head for one look. Karel Check fired first.
Anselm Rock did not get up.
Further down the line, the Concord chaplain Bram Hop knelt by a wounded man. A Hegemony sniper found him there.
Four Concord men fell. Every one of them was shot.
But the real killer was behind the Hegemony line.
Eighty wounded. Thirteen medics. Every bed taken. Seventeen men on stretchers, in the rain.
Nineteen of them died waiting for a doctor. Two of the dead were medics themselves.
Now the fight is for Blackwater Canal.
The first side to kill one hundred enemy soldiers takes it. Concord twenty-one. Hegemony four.
So each side must choose what it needs most.
A bigger hospital. Concrete pillboxes. Or an ammunition train. Comment one word.
Yesterday, fifty-three new men came up the line.
Comment Concord... or Hegemony. Link in bio.
Mud and Iron. Every follower is a soldier.
